description: Return the code point at a zero-based index of the <dataType> value as an integer, as ECMAScript s.codePointAt(i) does. Indexes count code points, as everywhere in Adaptive Script (not UTF-16 units). Negative indexes count from the end, as at does. If the index is out of range, the result is undefined, as for at.

parameters.description: Zero-based code point index, or negative from the end.
parameters.name: index

returns.description: The code point, or undefined if index is out of range.
